cases.sentence: На узком операционном ___ лежал раскинувшись пес Шарик
cases.translation: On the narrow operating table lay the sprawled-out dog Sharik.
cases.explain: The preposition «на» expressing location governs the Prepositional case, so стол becomes столе.

cases.sentence: ___, тяжело дыша и спеша, машинкой въедаясь в шерсть, стриг голову Шарика
cases.translation: The doctor, breathing heavily and hurrying, biting into the fur with the clippers, was shaving Sharik's head.
cases.explain: «Доктор стриг» — the doctor is the subject performing the action, so he stands in the Nominative.

cases.sentence: Доктор Барменталь, тяжело дыша и спеша, машинкой въедаясь в шерсть, стриг ___ Шарика
cases.translation: Doctor Bormenthal, breathing heavily and hurrying, biting into the fur with the clippers, was shaving Sharik's head.
cases.explain: The transitive verb «стриг» (was clipping) takes a direct object in the Accusative, so голова becomes голову.

cases.translation: Bormenthal threw aside the clippers and armed himself with a razor.
cases.explain: The verb «вооружился» (armed himself with) takes an Instrumental complement, so бритва becomes бритвой.

cases.sentence: Он метко и длинно протянул по ___ шарика рану
cases.translation: With a precise, long stroke he drew a wound along Sharik's belly.
cases.explain: The preposition «по» meaning "along the surface of" governs the Dative case, so живот becomes животу.

cases.sentence: Филипп Филиппович залез в глубину и в несколько поворотов вырвал из ___ шарика его семенные железы
cases.translation: Filipp Filippovich reached deep inside and, with a few twists, tore Sharik's reproductive glands out of his body.
cases.explain: The preposition «из» (out of) governs the Genitive case, so тело becomes тела.

reading.ru: На узком операционном столе лежал раскинувшись пес Шарик, и голова его беспомощно колотилась о белую клеенчатую подушку.
reading.question: What is the opening image of the operation scene?
options: Sharik lying sprawled on a narrow operating table, his head helplessly knocking against an oilcloth pillow
Sharik running free in the courtyard
Sharik eating a meal at the table
Sharik sleeping peacefully in his basket
reading.correct: Sharik lying sprawled on a narrow operating table, his head helplessly knocking against an oilcloth pillow
reading.explain: The chapter opens with Sharik sprawled on the narrow operating table, his head helplessly bumping against the white oilcloth pillow.

reading.ru: Филипп Филиппович, опершись ладонями на край стола, блестящими, как золотые обода его очков, глазами, наблюдал за этой процедурой и говорил взволнованно.
reading.question: How does Filipp Filippovich behave while observing the shaving of Sharik's head?
options: He leans on the table, watches with shining eyes, and speaks in an agitated way
He falls asleep in his chair
reading.correct: He leans on the table, watches with shining eyes, and speaks in an agitated way
reading.explain: He leans his palms on the edge of the table, watches with eyes shining like the gold rims of his glasses, and speaks with agitation.

reading.ru: Из-под выстриженной шерсти засверкала беловатая кожа собаки.
reading.question: What becomes visible once the dog's fur is clipped away?
reading.explain: Once the fur is clipped away, the dog's whitish skin glints through underneath.

reading.ru: Обрив голову, тяпнутой мокрым бензиновым комочком, обтер ее, затем оголенный живот пса растянул и промолвил, отдуваясь.
reading.question: What does Bormenthal do right after shaving Sharik's head?
options: He wipes it with a gasoline-soaked cloth and stretches out the dog's bared stomach
He gives the dog an injection
reading.correct: He wipes it with a gasoline-soaked cloth and stretches out the dog's bared stomach
reading.explain: After shaving the head, he wipes it with a wet ball soaked in gasoline, then stretches out the dog's bared stomach, sighing.

reading.ru: Легкими марлевыми салфеточками он обложил голову шарика, и тогда на подушке оказался никем не виданный лысый песий череп и странная бородатая морда.
reading.question: What strange sight appears once Bormenthal arranges the gauze around Sharik's head?
options: A never-before-seen bald dog skull with a strange bearded muzzle
reading.correct: A never-before-seen bald dog skull with a strange bearded muzzle
reading.explain: Once he covers the head with light gauze pads, the pillow reveals a never-before-seen bald canine skull with a strange bearded muzzle.

reading.ru: И взмахнув ножичком, он метко и длинно протянул по животу шарика рану.
reading.question: What does Filipp Filippovich do with the small knife on Sharik's stomach?
options: He makes a precise, long incision along the belly
He only makes a tiny scratch
He hands it back to Bormenthal unused
reading.correct: He makes a precise, long incision along the belly
reading.explain: With a swing of the little knife, he draws a precise, long wound along Sharik's stomach, and the skin parts with blood spraying out.

reading.ru: Филипп Филиппович залез в глубину и в несколько поворотов вырвал из тела шарика его семенные железы с какими-то обрывками.
reading.question: What does Filipp Filippovich remove from deep inside Sharik's body?
options: Sharik's reproductive glands, along with some scraps of tissue
A foreign object Sharik had swallowed
reading.correct: Sharik's reproductive glands, along with some scraps of tissue
reading.explain: He reaches deep inside and, with a few twists, tears out Sharik's reproductive glands along with some shreds of tissue, to be replaced with human ones.

reading.ru: Он оскалил фарфоровые и золотые коронки и одним приемом навел на лбу шарика красный венец.
reading.question: What does Filipp Filippovich do to Sharik's forehead with the knife?
options: He draws a red ring/crown-shaped incision across it in one motion
He shaves it completely bald without cutting
He avoids touching the forehead at all
reading.correct: He draws a red ring/crown-shaped incision across it in one motion
reading.explain: Baring his porcelain and gold teeth, he draws a red 'crown' incision on Sharik's forehead in a single stroke, preparing to open the skull.

reading.ru: Минуты через три крышку черепа с шарика сняли.
reading.question: What is removed from Sharik's skull after about three minutes of sawing?
options: The top of the skull (the skull cap)
reading.correct: The top of the skull (the skull cap)
reading.explain: After about three minutes of sawing around the skull, the cap of Sharik's skull is lifted off, exposing the dome of his brain.

reading.ru: Он ободрал оболочку с мозга и пошел куда-то вглубь, выдвигая из вскрытой чаши полушарие мозга.
reading.question: What does Filipp Filippovich do after opening the membranes covering the brain?
options: He strips the membrane off and pushes deeper, drawing out a hemisphere of the brain
He hands the instruments to Zina
reading.correct: He strips the membrane off and pushes deeper, drawing out a hemisphere of the brain
reading.explain: He strips the membrane from the brain and pushes further in, drawing a hemisphere of the brain out of the opened cavity.

reading.ru: Доктор с размаху легко всадил иглу в сердце пса.
reading.question: What emergency action does Bormenthal take when Sharik's pulse drops sharply?
options: He plunges a needle straight into the dog's heart
reading.correct: He plunges a needle straight into the dog's heart
reading.explain: With a sweeping motion, the doctor easily plunges the needle into the dog's heart to fight the falling pulse.

reading.ru: И своими короткими пальцами, ставшими точно чудом, тонкими и гибкими, ухитрился янтарной нитью его там замотать.
reading.question: How does Filipp Filippovich manage to secure the new pituitary gland in place?
options: With his short fingers turned miraculously thin and nimble, he ties it in place with amber-colored thread
He uses a special machine to weld it
He simply presses it in without stitching
He asks Bormenthal to do it instead
reading.correct: With his short fingers turned miraculously thin and nimble, he ties it in place with amber-colored thread
reading.explain: His stubby fingers become, as if by miracle, thin and flexible, letting him tie the new gland in place with amber thread.

reading.ru: Профессор оболочками забросал мозг, отпиленную крышку приложил, как по мерке.
reading.question: How does the professor close up the brain and skull at the end of the operation?
options: He covers the brain with the membranes and fits the sawn-off skull cap back on as if measured to size
He leaves the skull open for observation
He replaces the skull cap with a metal plate
He asks Zina to finish the job
reading.correct: He covers the brain with the membranes and fits the sawn-off skull cap back on as if measured to size
reading.explain: The professor covers the brain with its membranes again and fits the sawn-off skull cap back into place as though it had been custom-measured.

reading.ru: Тут же Филипп Филиппович отвалился окончательно, как сытый вампир, сорвал одну перчатку, выбросив из нее облако потной пудры, другую разорвал, швырнул на пол и позвонил, нажав кнопку в стене.
reading.question: What does Filipp Filippovich do immediately after finishing the surgery?
options: He slumps back like a sated vampire, tears off his gloves, and rings a bell in the wall
He immediately begins a second operation
He leaves the room without a word
reading.correct: He slumps back like a sated vampire, tears off his gloves, and rings a bell in the wall
reading.explain: He finally slumps back like a sated vampire, rips off his gloves in a cloud of powder, throws them down, and presses the wall button to call Zina.

reading.question: How does Filipp Filippovich describe Sharik in his final words of the chapter?
options: As the ugliest dog he has ever seen
reading.explain: Looking at the seemingly dying dog, Filipp Filippovich says he feels sorry for him, calling him affectionate, though cunning.
